evidence: Labeled 'Fuzzing' and adds a reusable reachability-goal tracking framework across fuzz harnesses under `src/test/fuzz/`.
rationale: Prevents silent fuzz coverage regressions by adding CI-enforceable reachability goals across 11 targets. As noted in commit bcf97a3cc4, this 'allows corpus CI to detect lost path coverage without a separate build configuration,' ensuring critical paths like handshakes and package validation remain exercised.
